Based on the provided web search results from the official The Odds API documentation, here are the real, publicly available API rate limits and pricing tiers as of 2026:

### Pricing Tiers

The Odds API offers three pricing tiers ([theoddsapi.com](https://theoddsapi.com/pricing)):

1. **Free Tier**: $0/month
   - 25 requests/day
   - Limited to NBA + MLB sports
   - Moneyline (h2h) markets only
   - US sportsbooks only
   - No credit card required

2. **Professional Tier**: $29/month (Most Popular)
   - 20,000 requests/month
   - All 25 sports
   - h2h, spreads, and totals markets
   - US sportsbooks (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, BetRivers, etc.)

3. **Business Tier**: $99/month
   - 200,000 requests/month
   - 26 sports (including World Cup 2026)
   - All markets including player props, futures, period markets
   - 50+ international books including Pinnacle
   - Edge detection, fair odds, consensus, arbitrage features
   - Full historical archive at zero extra credit cost

### Rate Limits and Usage Management

**Monthly Usage Credits**: Usage credits reset on the first of every month ([the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/faqs.html)). The API provides response headers to track usage:
- `x-requests-remaining`: Usage credits remaining until quota reset
- `x-requests-used`: Usage credits used since last quota reset
- `x-requests-last`: Usage cost of the last API call

**Request Rate Limiting**: The API has a rate limit of 30 API calls per second ([the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html)). Requests exceeding this limit receive HTTP status code 429 (Too Many Requests).

**Caching**: 304 responses via ETag caching cost zero credits - if odds haven't changed since your last poll, the request is free ([theoddsapi.com](https://theoddsapi.com/pricing)).

**Error Handling**: When monthly quotas are reached, the API returns a 429 response instead of charging overage fees. There is no metered overage billing ([theoddsapi.com](https://theoddsapi.com/faq)).

All information is current as of the search date (2026-08-29) and comes directly from The Odds API's official documentation and pricing pages.
